fileNodes.name: github-stats.yml
fileNodes.summary: Scheduled GitHub Actions workflow that generates public-only GitHub language statistics and publishes the SVG assets to the generated branch.
fileNodes.languageNotes: Uses YAML workflow syntax with scheduled and manual triggers, shell validation, and branch publishing steps.

fileNodes.name: repo-cards.yml
fileNodes.summary: Scheduled GitHub Actions workflow that runs the repository card generator and publishes its rendered cards to the cards branch.
fileNodes.languageNotes: Runs a Python script on a daily schedule or manual dispatch, then publishes only changed card assets.

fileNodes.name: snake.yml
fileNodes.summary: Scheduled GitHub Actions workflow that generates contribution-snake SVGs and a 3D profile graph, publishing them to output and main branches.
fileNodes.languageNotes: Uses third-party GitHub Actions to generate visual assets on a daily schedule or manual dispatch.
